'''Flameout''' was an extremely strong [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage that, when mixed correctly, was known for producing sensations similar to a scalding of the [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] and a freezing of the throat; the secret ingredient in this concoction was [[Spice/Legends|spice]].

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was known to enjoy this drink in his early [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]].
